title: Invoice request
description: The body of POST /offers/{offer_id}/invoice and of POST /offers/{offer_id}/check, as a wallet writes it (docs/spec-v1.md, sections 7.2 and 11.1). A cycle of a recurring offer carries all four subscription members; a request on any other offer carries none of them. The reference resolver also accepts an amount written as a number and an asset in another letter case; a wallet should not rely on that.

asset.description: One of the offer's assets. Defaults to the first.

idempotency_key.description: May instead be sent as the Idempotency-Key header.

subscriber_signature.description: By the subscription key, over the canonical JSON of the object in recurrence-proof.schema.json.

scheduled_for.description: When the payer's schedule called for this cycle. Part of what the subscriber signs when present.
